output.reason: [ev-18ac53d77b4b] only says that istio-clean-iptables now removes kube-virt-related rules it used to leave behind. Nothing fails, gets rejected or stops being honoured, so behavior-change (review) is the right kind. correction.statement: In Istio 1.24.0 the istio-clean-iptables tool removes kube-virt-related iptables rules that it previously left in place; the cleanup still works but now removes more rules than before.

consequence.statement: The istio-clean-iptables tool will now remove kube-virt-related iptables rules, whereas previously such rules were not being removed.
consequence.remediation: No action required; check that cleanup runs that previously left kube-virt-related rules in place now remove them as expected.
